answer: Stylometric clustering: each epoch every answer is embedded and compared with answers from the last 30 epochs. Keys whose writing stays inside a tight cosine radius on 5+ epochs are merged into one payee, the way flaws trace cut quartz back to one seam. A 1,000-key farm must then fund 1,000 genuinely distinct authors, about $2 of fresh prompting and editing per key per epoch, or see rewards collapse to one share; a velvet paraphrase on the same voyage of ideas still clusters.
